title: feat(studio): expand block config + array/string-list property editors
body:
Builds on #1491. Adds configurable property panels for more page-editor blocks (element:number, element:button, record:alert) and introduces array-valued editors in the block inspector: a string-list editor (record:highlights fields) and an add/remove array-of-objects editor (page:tabs items, record:details sections with nested string-list fields). The inspector field renderer is generalized to drive nested array-item editors.

Browser-verified: number/button panels, page:tabs array (add tabs, edit key/label), record:highlights string-list (add field). Unit tests updated (4).

Follow-up: prune shell-chrome blocks from the page palette.
